**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/17 (Fri) 22:07
- [EVENT] User is planning a trip to Orlando, Florida.
- [PREFERENCE] User wants to know which theme parks are a must-visit for thrill rides.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Universal's Islands of Adventure is recommended as a top theme park for thrill rides.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Incredible Hulk Coaster is a high-speed roller coaster with a launch from 0 to 40 mph in 2 seconds.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hollywood Rip Ride Rockit is a roller coaster with a 90-degree lift hill and a non-inverting loop.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey is a thrilling dark ride with a broomstick flight experience.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Universal Studios Florida has thrill rides like Revenge of the Mummy, which is a high-speed indoor roller coaster with a launch from 0 to 45 mph in 2 seconds.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] SeaWorld Orlando has thrill rides like Mako, Kraken, and Manta, which are intense roller coasters with steep drops, loops, and corkscrews.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Busch Gardens Tampa Bay is about an hour outside of Orlando and has world-class thrill rides like SheiKra, Montu, and Kumba.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Disney's Hollywood Studios has some thrill rides like Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith and Tower of Terror.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User asked for the best way to get to Universal's Islands of Adventure from their hotel in downtown Orlando.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Driving and parking at Universal Orlando Resort costs around $20-$30 per day.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Uber/Lyft ride-hailing from downtown Orlando to Universal's Islands of Adventure costs approximately $20-$30 and takes around 20-30 minutes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Taxi rides from downtown Orlando to Universal's Islands of Adventure cost around $30-$40 and take around 20-30 minutes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Public transportation via Lynx Bus 40 takes around 45 minutes to an hour and costs $2.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some hotels in downtown Orlando offer shuttle services to Universal Orlando Resort.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mears Transportation offers a shuttle service from various locations in downtown Orlando to Universal Orlando Resort for around $20-$30 per person.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User inquired about thrill rides at SeaWorld Orlando similar to the Revenge of the Mummy rollercoaster.
